versions.changelog: Add a claim ledger and sparse-proof fallback; prevent invented event details, customer proof, product capabilities, integrations, and metrics.

- Expanded description with multilingual usage examples and keywords (Chinese, German, Japanese, Spanish).
- Added non-English invitation terms and prompts to improve searchability and guidance for writing booth invites in multiple languages.
- No logic or workflow changes; instructional content and output structure remain the same.
Sharpened skill descriptions and first-screen README summaries for clearer ClawHub discovery, faster fit assessment, and stronger install intent.
Workflow and handoff refinements across pre-show, on-site, and post-show skills. Improved trigger boundaries, decision-oriented outputs, and cross-skill next-step guidance.

- Initial release of Booth Invitation Writer.
- Generates professional, personalized pre-show invitation emails and outreach sequences for trade shows.
- Supports multiple audience types with tailored templates (prospects, customers, partners, VIPs).
- Offers A/B subject line testing, multilingual output, and sequenced outreach options.
- Includes practical tips for timing, personalization, and CRM merge tag use.
- Encourages tailored, concise messaging over generic booth invites.
